svg.title: Chopped into chunks, cooked in parallel sub-kitchens, served as one meal
svg.desc: A big raw 3-D block of image data lies on a chopping board. A knife cuts it along a grid into eight smaller pieces, the chunks of an OME-Zarr store. The pieces travel in parallel to four small sub-kitchens, the parallel workers; each kitchen cooks one piece at a time on its stove (the piece turns from purple to orange while cooking, then green when done), so only a few pieces are in work at once. The cooked pieces are assembled on one plate into the finished meal, the result block, which glows before the cycle repeats.
